purpose: Any coding agent working in this repo: claims a task, changes code on a branch, opens a PR that CI gates and auto-merges.

task.description: ACS task id (HACK-NN) or GitHub issue

rules: Never write vendored ACS files (acs/seat_protocol.py, acs/watchdog_check.py, acs/LICENSE.acs, acs/assignment.schema.json)
Never commit cache/, runs/, data/, logs/ or any secret
Check repo.manifest.json before adding a top-level file or folder

Never hand-write custom code when mature OSS or an existing tool plus thin glue code can do the job; manual coding is allowed only for confirmed debugging or fixing logic pipelines (AGENTS.md, Reuse before you write)

A PR that adds a source file or more than 150 non-test lines under app/, acs/ or tools/ needs an 'OSS considered' section naming a specific project or SDK and why it does not fit, or a bugfix label or line plus Closes #N for an issue with confirmed evidence; tools/pr_policy.py enforces it in gates
Call providers through their official SDK when one exists instead of raw httpx or requests (AGENTS.md, Dependencies and SDKs)

Add direct dependencies to requirements.in and regenerate the requirements.txt lock with the uv command in its header; new packages must pass the license allowlist, pip-audit and the 12-month release check (tools/dep_policy.py)
